entities.name: Phenylalanine ammonia-lyase
observations: The 705-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt O49836, phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 2 from Lithospermum erythrorhizon.
The protein belongs to the Pfam Lyase_aromatic domain family PF00221, spanning residues 52–525.
Curated homolog annotations assign EC 4.3.1.24 and the reaction L-phenylalanine = (E)-cinnamate + NH4(+).
The enzyme is annotated as cytoplasmic and homotetrameric.
A conserved post-translationally generated 2,3-didehydroalanine (Ser) residue and an Ala-Gly 5-imidazolinone cross-link are reported in the exact reference protein.

entities.name: Phenylpropanoid metabolism
observations: Phenylalanine ammonia-lyase catalyzes the entry step from L-phenylalanine into phenylpropanoid metabolism by producing trans-cinnamate.
The pathway supports biosynthesis of diverse plant phenylpropane-derived natural products.

entities.name: L-phenylalanine to trans-cinnamate
observations: EC 4.3.1.24; Rhea RHEA:21384. The reaction is a non-oxidative deamination of L-phenylalanine yielding (E)-cinnamate and ammonium.
